name: Email Template Builder for WooCommerce & Easy Digital Downloads
author: Smackcoders Inc.,

sections.description:
Email Template Builder for WooCommerce & Easy Digital Downloads replaces the plain default emails your store sends with templates you design yourself. Drag blocks onto a canvas, drop in live order data, style everything to match your brand, and publish. No HTML, no child theme edits, no developer.

It is built for WooCommerce store owners, Easy Digital Downloads store owners, agencies and freelancers who manage client stores, and ecommerce marketers who want order confirmations, processing and shipping notifications, customer notes and download-delivery emails to look like the rest of the brand instead of a default template.

Everything described on this page is included in the plugin. The ecommerce blocks, merge tags, AI assistance and template import and export are all available from the moment you activate.

This is a transactional email plugin, not a newsletter tool. It does not manage lists or send campaigns the way Mailchimp or a marketing automation platform does. It controls the design and content of the emails WooCommerce and Easy Digital Downloads already send at checkout, on status change and on account events, which are the emails customers actually open.

Visual drag-and-drop email builder

Version 2.0 is a complete rebuild. The builder is a modern React interface, so blocks move, reorder and update live instead of forcing you to save and reload to see a change.

You work with a block library rather than a code editor:

  • Drag blocks into position and reorder them freely
  • Edit copy, colours, spacing and typography inline
  • Control how individual blocks behave on desktop and on mobile

The result is a visual email editor that a marketer can use directly, with output clean enough that a developer does not have to fix it afterwards.

WooCommerce email templates

Dedicated WooCommerce blocks pull real order data into the template, so one design serves every order:

  • Order Details and Order Items, including product thumbnail images
  • Billing Address and Shipping Address
  • Payment Method and Shipping Method
  • Order Totals and subtotals
  • Refund Details for both full and partial refunds
  • Customer Note
  • A WooCommerce Hooks block that renders standard action hooks such as woocommerce_email_before_order_table and woocommerce_email_after_order_table, so third-party plugins that inject content into WooCommerce emails keep working inside your custom template

With these you can rebuild a WooCommerce order confirmation as a branded receipt, present order items with thumbnails instead of a bare table, or design a refund notification that clearly explains the amount returned.

Easy Digital Downloads email templates

Easy Digital Downloads support is new in 2.0 and is handled with its own blocks and its own dynamic data, not by reusing WooCommerce fields:

  • EDD Order Items
  • EDD Order Summary
  • EDD Download Links
  • EDD Payment Details
  • EDD dynamic placeholders for customer, order and download data

For a digital store, the purchase email is the product delivery. These blocks let you present download links inside a designed, branded template rather than the default plain layout, and give payment and order information the visual hierarchy it needs.

Content blocks

Alongside the ecommerce blocks, the library covers what a transactional email normally needs: Text, Image, Button, Heading, Divider, Table, Social Icons, Header and Menu/Navbar.

Every block in the library is supported by the HTML email rendering engine, so anything you can build in the editor is something the plugin can actually send.

Dynamic content and merge tags

A placeholder and merge tag system injects supported customer, order, product, WooCommerce and Easy Digital Downloads data into your templates at send time.

You design one template. Every recipient sees their own name, their own order number, their own items and totals. There is no need to maintain a separate template per scenario just to change the details, and no risk of a hardcoded value going out to the wrong customer.

Responsive HTML email rendering

Email clients are not browsers. Every block you place in the builder is converted into table-based email HTML with inline CSS, which is the structure email clients handle most predictably, and the output is responsive so templates adapt on smaller screens.

Email rendering still varies between clients and versions. The export engine is designed to improve compatibility across common email clients rather than to guarantee identical rendering everywhere, and testing against your own audience’s clients is always worthwhile.

Styling and design controls

Design control is at the individual element level, not just the template level:

  • Borders, margin and padding
  • Typography hierarchy, colours and line height
  • Responsive visibility toggles, so a block can show on desktop and hide on mobile, or the reverse
  • Global LTR and RTL text direction across all blocks, for stores selling into Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu-speaking markets

This is enough control to match a brand’s spacing and type scale without touching CSS.

Template management, import and export

Templates behave like the rest of WordPress content, with publish, draft and trash states, plus duplication for building a variant without starting over.

A JSON import and export engine moves templates between sites. That matters if you build on staging and deploy to production, run the same base design across several client stores, or want a file-level backup of a template before a redesign. Templates stay in your own files and your own database.

AI-assisted copy and images

The builder includes optional AI assistance for the parts of email design that stall people: writing the copy and finding an image.

  • Generate draft body copy for a template
  • Summarise longer text down to email length
  • Adjust the tone of existing copy

AI requests run through WordPress connectors using your own API key from a supported provider (OpenAI, Google or Anthropic). Nothing is sent anywhere until you configure a provider and use one of these features. See the External Services section below for details.

AI here is a writing and design assistant inside the editor. It does not send emails, build campaigns or make targeting decisions.

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Create a template or duplicate an existing one
  3. Assign it to the email you want to change
  4. Build the layout with drag-and-drop blocks
  5. Add WooCommerce or Easy Digital Downloads blocks and merge tags for live data
  6. Style spacing, type and colour, and set desktop or mobile visibility
  7. Publish

Who it is for

  • WooCommerce store owners who want their emails to match their storefront
  • Easy Digital Downloads store owners delivering products by email
  • Agencies and freelancers managing templates across multiple client sites
  • Ecommerce marketers using post-purchase emails as a brand surface
  • Developers who want a maintainable template layer instead of overridden email templates in a child theme

Links and support

  • Documentation
  • Email support@smackcoders.com for help or feature requests

External services

The AI features in this plugin connect to a third-party AI provider that you choose and configure yourself, using WordPress connectors and your own API key. The plugin does not include or proxy any AI service of its own.

No data is sent to any external service unless you have configured a provider and actively use AI text or image generation inside the editor. If you never configure a provider, the plugin makes no external requests.

When you use an AI feature, the text prompt you enter, and any text you have selected for summarisation or tone adjustment, is sent to the provider you configured, and the generated text or image is returned to the editor.

WooCommerce and Easy Digital Downloads are WordPress plugins running on your own site. Integration with them is local and sends no data to any external service.
sections.installation:
From the WordPress dashboard:

  1. Go to Plugins, then Add New
  2. Search for “Email Template Builder for WooCommerce & Easy Digital Downloads”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate

Manual upload:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins, then Add New, then Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

After activation, the plugin’s menu is available in the WordPress admin sidebar, where you can create and manage email templates.

WooCommerce is required for WooCommerce email templates and blocks. Easy Digital Downloads is required for EDD email templates and blocks. You can run the plugin with either one, or both.
sections.faq:
How do I customize WooCommerce emails without coding?

Create a template in the visual builder, drag in the blocks you want, and assign the template to the email you are replacing. You never edit a template file or override anything in a child theme.

Can I create custom WooCommerce order email templates?

Yes. WooCommerce-specific blocks cover order details, order items with product thumbnails, billing and shipping addresses, payment and shipping methods, totals and subtotals, refund details and customer notes.

Does this replace WooCommerce’s default email templates?

Your custom templates are used in place of the default layouts for the emails you assign them to. WooCommerce still triggers and sends the emails; this plugin controls how they look and what they contain.

Will plugins that add content to WooCommerce emails still work?

The WooCommerce Hooks block renders standard WooCommerce email action hooks, including woocommerce_email_before_order_table and woocommerce_email_after_order_table, so content injected by other plugins can still appear inside your custom template. Place the block where you want that content to render.

Does it support Easy Digital Downloads?

Yes. Version 2.0 adds EDD support with dedicated blocks for EDD Order Items, EDD Order Summary, EDD Download Links and EDD Payment Details, plus EDD dynamic placeholders.

Can I personalise emails with customer and order data?

Yes. Dynamic placeholders and merge tags insert supported customer, order, product, WooCommerce and Easy Digital Downloads data into a template at send time, so a single design works for every recipient.

Are the emails responsive?

Builder blocks are exported as responsive, table-based email HTML with inline CSS, and individual blocks can be shown or hidden on desktop or mobile. Rendering still varies between email clients, so testing against your own audience is recommended.

Does the plugin support RTL emails?

Yes. Global LTR and RTL text direction is supported across all email blocks.

Can I duplicate, import or export templates?

Yes. Templates can be duplicated, and a JSON import and export engine moves templates between sites, which is useful for staging-to-production workflows and for agencies reusing a base design across client stores.

Does the plugin include AI features, and do I need my own API key?

The builder includes optional AI assistance for generating and summarising copy, adjusting tone, and generating images. It uses WordPress connectors with your own API key from OpenAI, Google or Anthropic. The plugin does not bundle AI credits, and no data leaves your site until you configure a provider and use one of these features.

Is there a paid version or a feature limit?

No. Every feature described here is part of the plugin, including the ecommerce blocks, merge tags, AI assistance, and template import and export.

Is this an email marketing plugin?

No. It designs transactional emails that WooCommerce and Easy Digital Downloads already send. It does not manage subscriber lists or send marketing campaigns.

I used version 1.x. What happens to my old templates?

Version 2.0 is a complete rebuild on a new editor. Back up your site and export or record your existing template designs before updating.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

Added:
* Rebuilt visual drag-and-drop email builder on a modern React interface
* Easy Digital Downloads support with EDD Order Items, EDD Order Summary, EDD Download Links and EDD Payment Details blocks, plus EDD dynamic placeholders
* WooCommerce blocks for order details, order items with product thumbnails, billing and shipping addresses, payment and shipping methods, order totals and subtotals, full and partial refund details, customer notes, and WooCommerce email action hooks
* Basic blocks: text, image, button, heading, divider, table, social icons, header and menu/navbar
* Dynamic placeholder and merge tag system for customer, order, WooCommerce and EDD data
* Template management with publish, draft and trash states, template duplication, and JSON import and export
* AI-assisted text generation, summarisation, tone adjustment and image generation through WordPress connectors, using your own OpenAI, Google or Anthropic API key
* Granular styling controls for borders, margin, padding, typography, colour, line height and responsive desktop/mobile visibility
* Global LTR and RTL text direction support across all blocks

Improved:
* HTML email export engine producing responsive, table-based email HTML with inline CSS
* Codebase refactored to PSR-4 object-oriented PHP with modular AJAX and REST API controllers

Removed:
* Legacy CKEditor and jQuery-based editor dependencies and deprecated helper files

1.7.2

  • Fixed: Security issue reported by WPScan
  • Checked: Compatibility for WordPress 6.1.1

1.7.1

  • Fixed: Vulnerability issues
  • Updated: Data sanitization, validation and output escaping
  • Added: wp-ajax nonce check for security

Earlier release history is available in changelog.txt.
